name: Smart Search's header button in Dark, Light, Apple TV and Purple Haze (localStorage '<userId>-appTheme', then a reload), as viewer: one button right before jellyfin-web's search button, in its colour and size in every theme. Screenshots smartsearch-header-theme-*.png.

steps.name: header helpers
one header button, shown right before jellyfin-web's search button (Dark)
steps.waitFor: (() => { const s = __hb.state(); return s.count === 1 && s.shown === 1 && s.nativeShown && s.before ? s : false; })()

steps.name: let the header's colour transition end (Dark)
the button takes the theme's header colours (Dark)
steps.eval: (() => { const b = __hb.ours()[0], n = __hb.native(); const cs = (e) => getComputedStyle(e); return { color: cs(b).color, nativeColor: cs(n).color, size: __hb.box(b).slice(2).join(), nativeSize: __hb.box(n).slice(2).join(), theme: [...document.querySelectorAll('link[href*="themes/"], link[href*="theme"]')].map(l => l.getAttribute('href')).join(' ') }; })()
